How it works

Your coffee. Their school fundraiser.

Every bag sold raises $5 for St. Rose of Lima School in Warwick, RI.

After the fundraiser closes, the coffee is produced and shipped in bulk to St. Rose of Lima School for local distribution. The school receives $5 for every bag sold.
